prose.text: "Why does a SAML criterion not match?" takes three questions in order.

steps.label: Is the attribute registered, and under which IdP?
steps.text: Registration, fields, the limit and the Authentication Service replacement are in [[zpa.saml-attributes.registration]].

steps.label: How does the rule use it?
steps.text: IdP selection, operators, the IdP setting that switches SAML criteria on and the Terraform form are in [[zpa.saml-attributes.policy-criteria]].

steps.label: What does the API or tooling see?
steps.text: Endpoints, fields, write support and the data source are in [[zpa.saml-attributes.api-surface]].

prose.text: SCIM attributes and groups are in [[zpa.scim]]; ZIA's SCIM attribute mapping is in [[zia.scim.attribute-mapping]].
